abstract: Covers The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format. RFC 8259 The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format is current; RFC 7493 The I-JSON Message Format is current. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
